validation.packed_cuda_kernel_oracle: Q1_0, Q2_0_G64, and Q2_0_G128 packed GEMV matches the f32 wire oracle on a real CUDA device
validation.q2_raw_parity_disclosure: all short legs exact; report all_pass=false because one 50-token leg diverges late at token 46
validation.q1_27b_cuda_performance: bonsai-27b-q1-cuda-performance.json; default POPC decode averaged 21.3805924341 tok/s versus 16.4639010553 tok/s disabled, reported as 29.864% at four-decimal rate display precision (29.863465% from the full-precision means) over 23 post-first tokens per run
validation.q1_27b_cuda_performance_correctness: identical generated text across all three default and all three POPC-disabled image runs
validation.q1_27b_cuda_performance_timing_boundary: image TTFT includes projection, prefill, and first-token production and is reported separately; it was 1.547% slower in this A/B, while end-to-end latency was 6.537% lower
validation.vision_disclosure: text is token-exact; image prompt-token counts align at the 128-token cap, while generated visual wording is coherent but not token-exact
validation.q2_27b_capacity: 36/64 trailing layers streamed from pinned host RAM on the 6144 MiB reference GPU
validation.insert_image_file: validated through the OpenAI-compatible image_url data part with vision_ready=true; the frontend contract exposes one local PNG/JPEG attachment when the projector is ready
